description: This is an assembly source file for the MIPS architecture that implements a bootloader, specifically a LZMA compressed kernel loader for Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX based boards. It contains startup routines, CPU register setup, cache management, relocation, and bss cleanup typical of low-level boot code.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Entry point for the bootloader; performs CPU register setup, cache initialization, relocation, BSS clearing, and jumps to the main loader routine.
